tvShow.name: Love Is Never Gone
tvShow.overview: Teo is a devoted son who dreams of a better life for his family. He falls victim to Yana, a cunning thief known as “Chameleon,” but soon learns she steals out of desperation to care for her sick mother. What begins in anger turns into love, forged through shared loss and sacrifice.  However, Yana’s ties to a crime syndicate lead to betrayal and Teo’s wrongful imprisonment, leaving him convinced she destroyed him. Years later, pardoned and back in the Philippines, Teo tries to rebuild his life, only to discover that Ace Verona’s wife, Gem, is the very image of Yana. As he infiltrates her world seeking justice, he uncovers dangerous secrets about the powerful Verona family and the shocking truth about Gem’s sacrifice to free him. Caught between love, betrayal, and the corruption of a ruthless clan, Teo is forced into a final reckoning where passion, vengeance, and survival collide—proving that love endures even after betrayal.

episodes.name: Chance Encounter
episodes.overview: Teo leaves for Morocco to give his family a better life, only to fall victim to a sly pickpocket, not once, but twice. Forced to work as a con artist, Yana begins planning her escape from the syndicate with her friends. Though their first encounters are unpleasant, Teo and Yana keep crossing paths, leading to an unexpected romance.

episodes.name: Farewell And A New Beginning
episodes.overview: Yana and her associates execute their plan to rob a wealthy sheikh and escape their boss. As her lies unravel and her mother dies, a chase ends with Teo shot and arrested. Years later, Teo gets released from prison and starts anew in the Philippines. Just when he finds a seemingly good opportunity, he meets someone who looks exactly like Yana.

episodes.name: The Stage for Deception
episodes.overview: Teo starts working for Ace, only to realize that serving his wealthy, influential family is far more complicated than he thought. All the while, he seizes the chance to secretly investigate Gem-whom he believes is Yana-until one telling difference gives him pause. However, unbeknownst to Teo, no stranger ever slips past this family unnoticed.

episodes.name: Searching for Truth
episodes.overview: Cracks in Ace and Gem's marriage begin to surface after the former fires Teo. Not long after Teo regains his job, Divino dismisses him upon uncovering his criminal records in Morocco. While an unlikely person steps in to defend him, Gem's disdain remains clear. Still unable to shake his suspicions, Teo finds another way to strip away Gem's pretense.

episodes.name: Silent Sacrifice
episodes.overview: Teo is shaken after witnessing Ace brutally assault Gem, realizing the depth of his obsession and cruelty. As he tries to confirm whether it was truly Gem who secured his freedom in Morocco, Teo begins to uncover the Veronas' darkest, filthiest secrets. Upon learning that their permanent move to the US has been canceled, Gem quietly sets her backup plan in motion.

episodes.name: Desperate Escape
episodes.overview: Teo investigates the Veronas' trafficking network and its possible connection to his mother's case. Larajean unexpectedly finds favor with Katarina-at Gem's expense. As Ace's jealousy and violent tendencies cross a dangerous line, Teo urges Gem to escape the Veronas before it's too late.

episodes.name: Kidnapped
episodes.overview: Ace and Gem are kidnapped in a planned ambush, while Teo is left behind, injured and unconscious. The kidnapper soon demands ransom, forcing Divino and Katarina to relive the same nightmare once more. With Ace's trauma resurfacing as he fights to escape captivity, Teo must confront Divino's growing doubts and relentless questioning.

episodes.name: Affair
episodes.overview: After a failed escape, Gem is forced back into the Veronas' grip. Driven by obsession, Ace intensifies his hunt for the kidnappers, even choosing to keep a suspected enemy close. Meanwhile, a familiar face from Morocco arrives at Teo's doorstep. Later, Gem takes some time off at a rest house, where her connection with Teo blossoms into something deeper and far more dangerous.

episodes.name: Captive
episodes.overview: Ace forces Gem and Teo to confess before the police intervene. As the Veronas move to detain Teo and frame him for frustrated murder, they lock the pregnant Gem inside the mansion under strict watch. While awaiting the paternity test results, Gem secretly plots her escape. Meanwhile, with their family under fire, Divino enlists a familiar face to support their illegal operations.

episodes.name: Reckoning
episodes.overview: Larajean's world crumbles upon learning that Gem is pregnant and that Teo may be the father. As Ace grows increasingly violent, Raya plans with Ronnie and Teo to help Gem escape. Caught in the crossfire, Teo receives help from a familiar face.

episodes.name: Unmasked
episodes.overview: Rita reveals to Teo the nightmare she endured overseas and how she became entangled with the Veronas. As Teo and Gem plot their escape, Rita risks everything, including her own safety, to protect her family. Meanwhile, Larajean's personal ties to the Crisantos have become a grave threat to the family she once considered her own.

episodes.name: Crossfire
episodes.overview: While the Veronas assume Pearl is dead, she finds sanctuary in Teo's camp. As Teo plans Gem and his whole family's escape, Alonzo openly criticizes his decisions. To make matters worse, last-minute changes complicate everything further, allowing Ace to track them down before they can get far.

episodes.name: Downfall
episodes.overview: Gem suffers a miscarriage following a scuffle with Raya. Burdened by guilt, the young Verona becomes Teo and Gem's unlikely ally in saving Issay from Divino. Determined to bring the Veronas down once and for all, Teo orchestrates a daring scheme to expose their illegal operations. But after learning about Teo's plan, Raya finds herself torn between protecting her family and doing what is right.

episodes.name: Resurrection
episodes.overview: With Pearl serving as the key witness, Divino and Katarina face the court and use their mastery of the law to their advantage. Meanwhile, Gem uncovers the truth about her biological parents while examining the data recovered from Pearl's laptop. But before she can reach Pearl and finally discover the truth about her identity, Gem is abducted by Ace's underlings to face his ultimate punishment.
